descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Account Manager Intermediaries (AM) takes ownership of the account administration, documentation formalities and tasks in daily operations and projects impacting the account administration.

The responsibilities include order placement, handling of client requests, execution of trades and providing administrative support to the team.

In contrast to the Relationship Manager (RM), the AM does not have an own client book. The AM reaches out to clients where appropriate in close collaboration with the RM.

He/she demonstrates excellent professional, personal as well as social skills when liaising with clients and the RM.

The AM ensures the operational client account management and interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders independently, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the AM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to clients, RMs and Group Head (GH) in a fast, professional and friendly manner, and thus, helping the team to manage and grow its current client base.

He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals and departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. The AM shows professional commitment to ensuring excellent administration of the account, to clients as well as to the Bank and is willing to go the extra mile.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports the RMs and the team in client interactions in all respects

• Responds to incoming calls and takes prompt action

• Maintains and updates records of client instructions, details, and preferences

• Creates system-based reports for the RMs

• Provides clients with verbal and/or written information and data, giving neither advice nor any statement of opinion as value judgement

• Handles and executes clients’ requests by processing orders, trades, transactions and, payments (outside e-channels)

Business Management

• Manages the internal projects which impact the account relationships of an RM, directly solving the administrative issues that arise and ensuring that all relevant systems are maintained and updated and all documentation collected as necessary

• Collects and shares relevant information, ideas, findings and research with colleagues to improve processes and to increase productivity and quality

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her own work at all times

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

Risk Management

• Full adherence at all times to compliance, legal guidelines, internal rules, regulations and policies

• Acts as the first line of risk defence, through raising concerns, following up on issues and escalating as necessary

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (on boarding of new clients, maintaining and extending current relationships)

• Sound affinity with the Middle East, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Excellent organisational skills, able to work swiftly, independently within the Account Manager’s scope and accurately even when under pressure

• Proactive, friendly, team player and solutions oriented

• Impeccable presentation and communication skills

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Strong integrity, ethics, and risk awareness combined with solid client-focused mindset

• Advanced knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

• Strong fluency in French and English (oral and written). Additional language an asset

• Very good MS Office skills

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che portate, permettendovi di essere impeccabili, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere potenziati e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Formiamo insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.

L'Assistente supporta il Team e i Relationship Manager (RM) con tutte le richieste Intermediari & FO e finali sugli aspetti di trading e operativi - con l'obiettivo di garantire operazioni senza soluzione di continuità e risposte rapide, competenti e complete. Le responsabilità includono il posizionamento degli ordini, la gestione delle richieste dei clienti, l'esecuzione dei pagamenti e il posizionamento dei prestiti e dei depositi. L'accuratezza e la tempestività sono fondamentali, con una gestione efficace delle richieste e dell'erogazione dei dati, più l'escalation a colleghi senior, se necessario. Il RM si affida all'Assistente per aiutare a promuovere e servire gli e-channel dedicati agli Intermediari & FO e per elaborare le relative richieste e richieste.
L'Assistente è coinvolto nello scambio continuo di informazioni con i RM, oltre che con i clienti sia gli stakeholder interni che esterni. In quanto tali, sono un modello di ruolo per l'assistenza clienti professionale, competente e di alta qualità e la fondazione dei nostri team di successo Front.

LA TUA SICUREZZA

• Supporta la RM e il team nell'interazione client in tutti gli aspetti

• Partecipa alle chiamate in arrivo e prende azione rapida

• Mantiene e aggiorna i record di istruzioni, dettagli e preferenze del cliente. Crea report basati sul sistema per la RM

• Fornisce ai clienti informazioni e dati verbali e/o scritti, senza dare né consigli né alcuna dichiarazione di opinione come valutazione del valore

• Elabora gli ordini, gli scambi, le transazioni, il posizionamento dei pagamenti (e-channel esterni) e gestisce ed esegue le richieste dei clienti

• Aiuta a promuovere l'uso e l'adozione dei nostri intermediari dedicati & FO e-channel

• Monitora l'elenco di scadenza per i depositi, i prestiti, i mestieri; agisce quando l'istruzione è standard, cerca istruzioni (da RM o cliente) se necessario e richiesto

• Organizza e segue riunioni dei clienti, compresa la logistica e la preparazione dei documenti

• Supporta la RM nelle indagini e nella risoluzione dei problemi, mantenendo stretta collaborazione tra le banche-interne/unità

• Aderenza completa in ogni momento alla conformità, linee guida legali, regole interne, regolamenti e politiche

• È una prima linea di difesa del rischio, attraverso l'aumento delle preoccupazioni, a seguito di problemi e l'escalation come necessario

Il tuo progetto

• Conoscenze fondazionali dei mercati finanziari: struttura, funzione e ambiente legale/regolatorio e consapevolezza del settore

• Esperienza comprovata che coinvolge intermediari finanziari, come uffici multifamiliari e/o gestori patrimoniali, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente di private banking o asset management

• Compresa comprensione dei prodotti e dei servizi pertinenti applicabili ai clienti EAM, oltre ai principi di valutazione

• Eccellente capacità organizzative, in grado di lavorare rapidamente, indipendentemente all'interno dell'ambito RM Assistant e con precisione anche sotto pressione

• Proattivo, amichevole e soluzione- così come l'atteggiamento orientato al cliente

• Forte giocatore di squadra con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione

• Aspetto professionale, integrità personale e alta consapevolezza del rischio / mentalità etica

• Molto buone competenze di MS Office

• Forte fluenza in inglese (orale e scritto) e altre lingue secondo il requisito di mercato

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completa attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro si possono trovare sul nostro sito Career.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant supports the Team and the Relationship Managers (RMs) with all Intermediaries & FO and end-client requests on trading and operational aspects - with the objective to ensure seamless operations and fast, competent and complete responses. Responsibilities include order placement, handling of client requests, payment execution and placement of loans and deposits. Accuracy and timeliness are paramount, with effective handling of enquiries and data provision, plus escalation to senior colleagues where necessary. The RM relies on the Assistant to help promote and service the e-channels dedicated to the Intermediaries & FO and to process the related requests and enquiries.
The Assistant is involved in the ongoing information exchange with RMs, plus both internal and external stakeholders in course of business with the clients. As such, they are a role model for professional, competent and high-quality client care and the foundation of our successful Front teams.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Supports the RM and team in client interaction in all respects

• Attends to incoming calls and takes prompt action

• Maintains and updates records of client instructions, details, and preferences. Creates system-based reports for the RM

• Provides clients with verbal and/or written information and data, giving neither advice nor any statement of opinion as value judgement

• Processes orders, trades, transactions, payments placement (outside e-channels) and handles and executes clients’ requests

• Helps to promote the usage and adoption of our dedicated Intermediaries & FO e-channels

• Monitors the maturity list for deposits, loans, trades; takes action where instruction is standard, seeks instructions (from RM or client) if necessary and required

• Organises and follows up client meetings, including logistics and document preparation

• Supports the RM in investigations and troubleshooting, maintaining close bank-internal cross-team/unit collaboration

• Full adherence at all times to compliance, legal guidelines, internal rules, regulations and policies

• Is a first line of risk defence, through raising concerns, following up on issues and escalating as necessary

YOUR PROFILE

• Foundational knowledge of financial markets: structure, function and legal/regulatory environment as well as industry awareness

• Proven experience engaging with financial intermediaries, such as multi-family offices and/or wealth managers, ideally within a private banking or asset management environment

• Profound understanding of relevant products and services applicable to EAM clients, plus valuation principles

• Excellent organisational skills, able to work swiftly, independently within the Assistant RM scope and accurately even when under pressure

• Proactive, friendly and solution- as well as customer-oriented attitude

• Strong team player with excellent communication skills

• Professional appearance, impactful and high personal integrity and risk awareness/ethical mindset

• Very good MS Office skills

• Strong fluency in German & English (oral and written)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements.

Der Assistent unterstützt das Team und die Relationship Manager (RMs) bei allen Intermediaries & FO- und Endkundenanfragen zu Handels- und Betriebsaspekten - mit dem Ziel, einen nahtlosen Betrieb und schnelle, kompetente und vollständige Antworten zu gewährleisten. Zu den Verantwortlichkeiten gehören Auftragserteilung, Bearbeitung von Kundenanfragen, Zahlungsausführung und Platzierung von Krediten und Einlagen. Genauigkeit und Pünktlichkeit sind von größter Bedeutung, mit einer effektiven Bearbeitung von Anfragen und Datenbereitstellung sowie einer Eskalation für ältere Kollegen, wo dies erforderlich ist. Die RM stützt sich auf den Assistenten, um die den Vermittlern & FO gewidmeten E-Kanäle zu fördern und zu warten und die damit verbundenen Anfragen und Anfragen zu bearbeiten.
Der Assistent ist am laufenden Informationsaustausch mit RMs sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern im Rahmen der Geschäfte mit den Kunden beteiligt. Als solche sind sie Vorbild für eine professionelle, kompetente und qualitativ hochwertige Kundenbetreuung und das Fundament unserer erfolgreichen Front-Teams.

IHRE HERAUSFORDERUNG

• Unterstützt das RM und Team bei der Kundeninteraktion in jeder Hinsicht

• Beteiligt sich an eingehenden Anrufen und ergreift sofortige Maßnahmen

• Behält und aktualisiert Aufzeichnungen von Kundenanweisungen, Details und Präferenzen. Erstellt systembasierte Berichte für die RM

• Bietet Mandanten mündliche und/oder schriftliche Informationen und Daten und gibt weder Ratschläge noch eine Stellungnahme als Werturteil.

• Verarbeitet Aufträge, Geschäfte, Transaktionen, Zahlungsplatzierung (außerhalb von E-Kanälen) und bearbeitet und führt Kundenanfragen aus

• Hilft, die Nutzung und Annahme unserer dedizierten Intermediaries & FO E-Kanäle zu fördern

• Überwacht die Fälligkeitsliste für Einlagen, Kredite, Trades; ergreift Maßnahmen, bei denen die Anweisung standardmäßig ist, sucht Anweisungen (von RM oder Client), falls erforderlich und erforderlich

• Organisiert und verfolgt Kundentreffen, einschließlich Logistik und Dokumentenvorbereitung

• Unterstützt die RM bei Untersuchungen und Troubleshooting und pflegt eine enge bankinterne team- und abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

• Vollständige Einhaltung von Compliance, gesetzlichen Richtlinien, internen Regeln, Vorschriften und Richtlinien

• Ist eine erste Linie der Risikoabwehr, indem Bedenken geäußert, Fragen verfolgt und bei Bedarf eskaliert

IHR PROFIL

• Grundkenntnisse der Finanzmärkte: Struktur, Funktion und rechtliches / regulatorisches Umfeld sowie Branchenbewusstsein

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Umgang mit Finanzintermediären wie Multi Family Offices und/oder Vermögensverwaltern, idealerweise in einem Private Banking- oder Asset Management-Umfeld

• Umfassendes Verständnis relevanter Produkte und Dienstleistungen für EAM-Kunden sowie Bewertungsgrundsätze

• Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, in der Lage, schnell, unabhängig im Assistant RM-Umfeld und auch unter Druck präzise zu arbeiten

• Proaktive, freundliche und lösungsorientierte sowie kundenorientierte Haltung

• Starker Teamplayer mit hervorragenden Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Professionelles Aussehen, wirkungsvolle und hohe persönliche Integrität und Risikobewusstsein / ethische Denkweise

• Sehr gute MS Office Fähigkeiten

• Starke Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch (mündlich und schriftlich) und anderen Sprachen entsprechend den Marktanforderungen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. C'est l'avenir de la gestion des richesses.

L'adjoint soutient l'équipe et les gestionnaires de relations (GR) avec toutes les demandes d'Intermediaries & FO et de clients finals sur les aspects commerciaux et opérationnels - avec l'objectif d'assurer des opérations sans faille et des réponses rapides, compétentes et complètes. Les responsabilités comprennent le placement des commandes, le traitement des demandes des clients, l'exécution des paiements et le placement des prêts et des dépôts. L'exactitude et l'actualité sont primordiales, avec un traitement efficace des demandes de renseignements et de la fourniture de données, et une escalade vers les collègues supérieurs au besoin. La RM s'appuie sur l'adjoint pour promouvoir et desservir les canaux électroniques dédiés aux intermédiaires et au FO et pour traiter les demandes et demandes connexes.
L'adjoint participe à l'échange continu d'information avec les RM, ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes et externes dans le cadre des activités avec les clients. En tant que tels, ils constituent un modèle de soins professionnels, compétents et de haute qualité pour nos clients et la base de nos équipes Front réussies.

Votre défi

• Soutient la RM et l'équipe dans l'interaction client à tous égards

• Assister aux appels entrants et agir rapidement

• Tenir et mettre à jour les dossiers des instructions, des détails et des préférences des clients. Crée des rapports basés sur le système pour la RM

• Fournit aux clients des informations et des données verbales et/ou écrites, ne donnant aucun avis ni aucune déclaration d'opinion comme jugement de valeur

• Traitement des ordres, métiers, transactions, placement des paiements (hors canaux électroniques) et traite et exécute les demandes des clients

• Aide à promouvoir l'utilisation et l'adoption de nos canaux électroniques dédiés Intermédiaires et FO

• Surveille la liste des échéances pour les dépôts, les prêts, les transactions; prend des mesures lorsque l'instruction est standard, demande des instructions (à la RM ou au client) si nécessaire et nécessaire

• Organiser et suivre les réunions des clients, y compris la logistique et la préparation des documents

• Soutient la RM dans les enquêtes et le dépannage, en maintenant une collaboration étroite entre les banques et les équipes/unités internes

• Respect intégral en tout temps de la conformité, des directives juridiques, des règles internes, des règlements et des politiques

• Est une première ligne de défense des risques, en soulevant des préoccupations, en assurant le suivi des questions et en intensifiant au besoin

VOTRE PROFIL

• Connaissance fondamentale des marchés financiers: structure, fonction et environnement juridique/réglementaire ainsi que sensibilisation de l'industrie

• Expérience éprouvée avec des intermédiaires financiers, tels que des bureaux multifamiliaux et/ou des gestionnaires de patrimoine, idéalement dans un environnement bancaire privé ou de gestion d'actifs

• Compréhension approfondie des produits et services pertinents applicables aux clients du MAE, plus les principes d'évaluation

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles, capables de travailler rapidement, indépendamment dans le cadre de la RM adjointe et avec précision même sous pression

• Une attitude proactive, amicale et orientée vers le client

• Fort joueur d'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences en communication

• L'apparence professionnelle, l'intégrité personnelle impactée et élevée et la sensibilisation au risque/l'état d'esprit éthique

• Très bonnes compétences MS Office

• Forte maîtrise de l'anglais (oral et écrit) et d'autres langues selon les exigences du marché
